DRLS.description: Diaphragm Disconnect (DRLS). Assigns a rigid-diaphragm disconnect to a node; the assignment is keyed by node number and carries no meaningful payload (the handler applies a default disconnect regardless of the body).

DUMMY.description: Placeholder value. Ignored by the write handler (OnSet always applies a default diaphragm-disconnect for the node key); present only because the DTO defines a single dummy field.
